subject: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@peopleops.co>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer

Hi team —

Following up from last week's 1:1s: the Data Infra lead (IC-3 role) on my squad is taking a confirmed 10-week medical leave starting 4/18. Given the current interview pipeline lag and timing on offers, I need a temporary coverage waiver to keep the headcount frozen and shore up a short-term transition plan rather than opening an immediate backfill.

As context:
- This is a high-skill, deep-domain role (model-serving infra) — ramp time for a new hire is ~4–6 months before independent impact.
- We have two short-term mitigations: pairing with Marco (SRE, part-time), and shifting one lower-priority project (A/B infra) off the roadmap for Q2.
- Hiring pipeline: Acme Analytics has one strong candidate but they are in final-stage at another company; earliest start would be late May if they accept.

What I'm requesting:
1) A formal freeze exception for this seat for up to 12 weeks (cover waiver) to allow an internal transition + candidate closure.
2) Approval for the attached transition plan (temporary role redistribution + on-call pairing budget).
3) Permission to re-open the req as an accelerated hire if Acme falls through after 6/7 weeks.

Attachments: org_change_form_SrDataInfra_20270404.pdf (form), transition_plan_draft.xlsx (proposed task split).

Why this matters: a rushed external hire now would increase cost and risk a poor fit; a short waiver preserves team velocity while we confirm candidate availability.

Could you review and confirm by EOD Thursday (4/8)? If you prefer, we can run this as a quick 10-minute sync.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Engineering Manager, Model Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@peopleops.co>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer

Thanks Steph — good summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off from an engineering prioritization POV: 

1) Can you quantify the velocity delta if we shift A/B infra off the roadmap (story points or expected deliverables delayed)? I want to make sure other squads won't absorb critical work.
2) Marco's availability: you said "part-time" — is that 20% or 40%? Is that sustainable for on-call?

Operationally I don't object to a 10–12 week waiver if we get a clear transition plan and a weekly check-in with SRE leads. Also would prefer a hard review at week 6 to decide whether to move to an accelerated external hire.

If you can update the transition_plan_draft.xlsx with the two items above I'll take another look and tentatively clear engineering sign-off.

— Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@peopleops.co>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer

Stephanie / Karthik —

I reviewed the org_change_form and the transition plan. Given the role seniority and the medical leave confirmed by PeopleOps, I'm comfortable approving a temporary coverage waiver under these conditions: 

• Duration: 12 weeks maximum starting 4/18 with an automatic week-6 formal review.
• Coverage: Marco commit must be at least 30% dedicated and a named contingency (Juan) for critical on-call windows.
• Budget: Approve one-time contractor spend up to $12k for 8 weeks (if additional short-term expertise is needed). PeopleOps (cc Elaine) — please confirm contractor approval path.

Please update the transition_plan_draft.xlsx with the availability numbers and include the proposed week-6 rubric (metrics: support ticket backlog, deploy lead time, critical alerts). Once that's in place I'll sign the org_change_form and route to Finance for the temporary contractor budget. 

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@peopleops.co>, Acme Analytics <recruiting@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer

Thanks all — appreciate the quick reviews and clear conditions. Summary / next steps: 

1) I'll update transition_plan_draft.xlsx with: Marco = 35% commit, Juan as named contingency, and the week-6 rubric (tickets backlog <= 15, median deploy lead time <= 6 hours, no P0s for >3 consecutive days).
2) Laura — will you sign the org_change_form once I upload the updated file? I'll put a redline showing the contractor cap for Finance.
3) Elaine / PeopleOps — requesting contractor approval path and confirmation on taking the medical leave documentation into the candidate hold record.
4) I'll schedule a 20-minute sync for Friday (4/9) to walk through the updated plan if anyone wants a real-time look.

If Acme confirms an offer and an acceptance before week 6 I'll update the req to accelerate hiring and record that decision in the ORG request.

Attaching the updated form after edits.

Best —
Stephanie

--Forwarded message appended for record--
From: Elaine Park <elaine@peopleops.co>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage waiver and transition plan for Sr. Data Infra engineer

Thanks — PeopleOps has logged the medical leave and I confirm the contractor path (Finance approval required for spend >$10k; org_change_form route is correct).

Elaine Park

PeopleOps
